description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractUserRole within the OrangeHRM system, providing base functionality for managing user roles and permissions, including methods for retrieving accessible entities, permissions checks, and role management, intended to be extended by specific user role implementations.

classes.name: AbstractUserRole
classes.description: A base class for user role management that encapsulates permission checking, entity access, and role-specific features within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the user role with a role name and role manager.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the authenticated user.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntities
methods.description: Deprecated method intended to retrieve entities of a specified type that the user can access; currently throws not implemented exception.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityProperties
methods.description: Deprecated method intended to retrieve accessible entity properties; currently throws not implemented exception.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityIds
methods.description: Returns a list of IDs for entities of a specified type that the user has access to, based on permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented in subclasses to fetch accessible IDs for a given entity type.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Stub method that can be overridden to return employees with this role.

methods.name: getAccessibleProjects
methods.description: Deprecated method for fetching accessible projects, currently returns an empty array.

methods.name: getAccessibleVacancies
methods.description: Deprecated method for fetching accessible vacancies, currently returns an empty array.

methods.name: areRequiredPermissionsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the necessary permissions are available for certain data groups and actions.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Returns a list of quick launch items accessible to the user based on permissions.
